versions.content: The function SomeIpXf_ExtractProtocolHeader- Fields specified in [SWS_SomeIpXf_91001] shall check whether the value of the 65 of 106 Document ID 660: AUTOSAR_SOMEIPTransformer Specification of SOME/IP Transformer AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Message Type field (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]) is equal REQUEST , RESPONSE , or ERROR .  If this is not the case, E_NOT_OK shall be returned. Neither messageType nor messageResult shall be modified in this case.
